SiteCheck — Terms of Service

Product by DNATech · Effective October 25, 2026
Overview: By installing or using SiteCheck ("the Software"), you agree to these Terms. SiteCheck is a local-first browser extension created by DNATech for website auditing, heading outline analysis, broken link discovery, and performance inspection.

1. Acceptance of Terms

By installing, accessing, or using the SiteCheck — Website Health Checker Chrome extension, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these Terms, please uninstall and discontinue use of the Software immediately.

2. Description of Service

SiteCheck is a browser utility developed by DNATech designed to assist web developers, system administrators, and site owners in auditing front-end website health, heading hierarchy, broken hyperlinks, image alternative attributes, metadata, and WordPress CMS indicators directly inside Google Chrome.
